technical_project_dataset_policy.default_behavior: Do not wait silently for the user to provide a dataset. Identify whether an official/public dataset is required, then either propose suitable official sources or ask for approval before using one.
avoid_dataset_sources: AI-generated data presented as empirical evidence
datasets unrelated to the dissertation scope
required_dataset_record: train validation test split where applicable
technical_project_dataset_policy.approval_rule: If dataset choice materially affects the methodology, cost, download size, runtime, ethics, or research scope, ask the user before downloading or committing to it.
